scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.speaker: Rose
scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.text: iya eon kita sa Caticlan. Sunod, sakay kita pa-Boracay.
scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.translation: We’re here at Caticlan. Next, we ride to Boracay.

scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.speaker: Papa Jobert
scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.text: Grabe, kaabo nga turista. Same as before, maybe even more now.
scene_1_caticlan_jetty_departure.translation: Wow, so many tourists. Same as before, maybe even more now.

scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.text: Mayad-ayad nga [DayPart], mga bisita! Welcome sa Boracay.

scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.speaker: Rose
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.text: This is my aunt, Tita Beth. She works in tourism here.

scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.text: iya kamo para magpahuway ag ma-enjoy ro baybay.
scene_2_arrival_at_boracay_white_beach.translation: You’re here to rest and enjoy the shore.

scene_3_tourism_lesson.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_3_tourism_lesson.text: ro turismo iya ro naga-suporta sa komunidad. bukon sa eamang sa negosyo, kundi pati sa trabaho it tanan.
scene_3_tourism_lesson.translation: Tourism here supports the community. Not just business, but jobs for everyone.

scene_3_tourism_lesson.speaker: Player
scene_3_tourism_lesson.text: So every visitor helps the locals too?

scene_3_tourism_lesson.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_3_tourism_lesson.text: hara gid. Kung magbakae ka sapag-obra, bukon eang souvenir — kundi suporta sa tawo nga nagahimo.
scene_3_tourism_lesson.translation: Exactly. When you buy a craft, it’s not just a souvenir — it’s support for the person who made it.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.text: Sakay — ride. Pahuway — rest. Eangoy — swim. Baybay — shore.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.text: Balik — return. Warang— travel. Bisita — visitor. Turista — tourist.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.speaker: Player
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.text: Okay, turista is me right now.

scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.speaker: Rose
scene_4_vocabulary_practice_round_touris.text: Correct. But you’re also balikbayan — returning home.

scene_5_finale_reflection.speaker: Lola Jonabel
scene_5_finale_reflection.text: indi ko malipatan do pag warang natun ngara, daya hay paeanumdum sa akong kabuhi .
scene_5_finale_reflection.translation: I’ll never forget this trip. It feels like a memory of my life.

scene_5_finale_reflection.speaker: Rose
scene_5_finale_reflection.text: And worth every word you’ve learned, balikbayan.

scene_5_finale_reflection.speaker: Tita Beth
scene_5_finale_reflection.text: dahan ka sa  pagbalik mo. ag ayaw pag lipati ro Aklan.
scene_5_finale_reflection.translation: Take care on your return. And don’t forget Aklan.
